diffs.to: the cluster's join token, made by the Control Plane, in /etc/rancher/k3s/cluster-token (0600)
k3s on srv restarts into this release; its Kubernetes node is not Ready for a while

decision.message: replaces the k3s binary (a release pinned by sha256) and restarts k3s on this node: a server's API is unavailable while it restarts, and an agent's node is not Ready
decision.hint: check the release against the k3s release page and that agents are not newer than the server; back up the server's data first

warnings.message: k3s is declared on srv, but nothing declares its service: the binary is installed and k3s is not started or kept running (the plan says in sync)
warnings.hint: declare the service of k3s on the node: Mamela.service(graph, node, "k3s", enabled: true, running: true)

warnings.message: k3s on srv runs v1.37.2+k3s1 and the declaration takes it back to v1.30.0+k3s1, a rollback of 7 minor releases: Kubernetes does not support downgrades, and what the newer release stored the older may not read
warnings.hint: if this is a typo, fix the version and the sha256; to really go back, restore the cluster from a snapshot taken at that release (Mamela does not roll a cluster back)
